Virtual Office

Virtual Office is a live view of the AI assistants on this laptop. When Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai or ChatGPT works on a request, the matching team member gets to work on it. Idle members sometimes walk over to the living corner for a snack (two at most), and everyone heads there for lunch at the dining table (12:00–13:00) and the coffee break set in Office setup. A new task calls them back: they start on their phone or laptop while walking to their desk.
